title: 云厂商加速AI基础设施与数据主权布局，SaaS深化垂直行业AI应用
core_insight: 云厂商在AI基础设施安全治理、主权云和边缘计算领域展开激烈竞争，SaaS厂商通过AI代理技术深度渗透金融、零售等垂直行业，同时AI监管风险和供应链安全挑战日益凸显

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出S3 Files将对象存储转为高性能文件系统，Google Cloud密集发布GKE AI优化功能包括Model Armor安全框架和Cloud Storage FUSE Profiles，微软展示Kubernetes操作成熟度进展，Cloudflare推出基于Astro 6.0的全栈无服务器CMS Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless支持秒级数据库创建，Bedrock Guardrails新增跨账户安全管控，Azure强化PostgreSQL企业级能力，Cloudflare客户端安全升级AI检测系统 Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems Guardrails at the gateway: Securing AI inference on GKE with Model Armor New GKE Cloud Storage FUSE Profiles take the guesswork out of configuring AI storage What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Cloudflare Client-Side Security: smarter detection, now open to everyone Amazon Bedrock Guardrails supports cross-account safeguards with centralized control and management Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds From legacy to leadership: How PostgreSQL on Azure powers enterprise agility and innovation
